name: real-shore
sentence: Build a small lakeside village of low houses facing the water, gathered around a market square, with no wall.

preregistered.written_before: the sentence was interpreted, the spec was written, the site was searched, the ground was cached, the place was laid out, anything was built or any finding was read
preregistered.model: no API key and no retrieval provider are configured. The `spec` and `judge` roles -- the interpretation, the place spec, the district characters, the preview reading and the revision -- are staged for the supervising terminal agent, which this project documents as a first-class runtime. SUPERVISED, not a fresh autonomous model pass.

expectations.interpretation/relation: the interpreter reads `gathered around a market square` as a relation between the houses and the square, and the cross-check records it as `read_only` because no phrase rule in this build can express a relation at all
expectations.absent/wall: satisfied, read from `no wall` and checked against every leaf of the plan by its own type
expectations.relation/around: measured as bearings about the square: satisfied only if the houses reach at least 3 of its 4 sides within the registered reach, and FAILED if they stand in a clump on one side of it. A market square with houses beside it is not houses gathered around a market square
expectations.quality/height/low: measured against the storey band each committed type declares, and never satisfied on the word alone
expectations.facing/water: satisfied only if a majority of the homes front the water beside them, none fronts away, and at least three quarters of them can be measured at all
expectations.capacity: each district's promise is the arrangement its own ground holds, laid by the construction logic that builds it. Where a district is short of the allocator's proposal, the ground and the fabric are tried and measured BEFORE any number moves, and the ladder is on the record
expectations.construction: the place is built offline and the construction check runs over what was built. Lint errors or a lane network in more than one piece BLOCK the run as `construction` and are not reported beside a finished place
expectations.revision: one bounded revision that changes a real consumer decision -- the arrangement, the fabric or the ground -- applied, rebuilt as needed and INSPECTED AGAIN. A no-op, a reordering of a record, or a revision that is rolled back does not count as recovery
expectations.qualification: `place_check` consumes the reading, the capability record and any judgment of THIS candidate. A place that does not answer its request blocks as `fidelity`. A judgment of an earlier candidate is not read against this one

bounds.plan_repair_passes: 2 per candidate, 6 per lineage; a deliberate revision opens a new lineage
bounds.district_growth: 0.5 of the rectangle the district was FIRST laid out as
bounds.scale_negotiation: no lower than 0.25 of the size band first accepted for the kind
